book.name: 2 K'oronttoosa
book.title: P'awuloosi K'oronttoosa Asaw S'aafeedda Laa'entso Kiitaa

content: Taani laa'entsuwaa hinttena kayyoyenna mala, hinttekko beennaadan, ta k'ofaa k'achchaad.
Ayaw gooppe, taani hinttena kayyoyiyaawaa gidooppe, ha taani kayyoyeedda hintte taana nashechchanaappe attin, oonee taana nashechchanawe?

Taani hinttenttoo he dabddaabbiyaa s'aafeeddawe, taana nashechchanaw bessiyaa asatuwaan taani kayyottanaw hinttekko baanaw koyabeennawaassa; taani nashettiyaa wode, hintte ubbaykka k'ay nashettanawaa hintte ubbaan ammanettay.
Ayaw gooppe, taani hinttenttoo daro waayiyaaninne tuggaan k'ay daro afotsaana s'aafeeddawe, hinttena kayyoyanaassa gidenna; shin taani hinttena ubbatuwaa ay keenaa siik'aytantto hintte eranaadaana.
Shin itti uray haraa kayyoyeeddawaa gidooppe, taani Aa yewuwaa darissanaw koyyikke; I hinttena ubbatuwaa kayyoyeeddappe attin, ta s'alalaa kayyoyibeenna.
Hintteppe dariyaa bagga Asay he bitaniyaa mala asaa hewaadan murooppe, he muray aw gidanawaa.
Hewaa diraw, he bitanii loytsi kayyottenna mala, hintte aw atto gaanawunne Aa mentsetsanaw bessee.
Hewaa diraw, hintte Aa minisiide siik'iyaawaa I erana mala, taani hinttena woossay.
Ayaw gooppe, hintte taw azazettanaw ubbaa wode giigi utteedditenttonne k'ay paac'iyaa hintte danddayintto eranaw, he dabddaabbiyaa hinttenttoo s'aafaad.
Itti uray naak'k'eeddawaa hintte atto giyaa wode, taanikka k'ay atto gay; taani atto geeddawaa gidooppe, atto geeddawaa ayaanne Kiristtoosa sintsan hintte diraw, atto gaad.
Sees'aanay nuukko yiide, nuuna c'immenna mala, taani aatto gaad; ayaw gooppe, nuuni Aa k'ofaa ereetto.
Taani Kiristtoosa mishiraachchuwaa k'aalaa odanaw S'iro'aadaa beedda wode, Goday yaan taw penggiyaa dooyyi wotseedda.
Taani ta ishaa Tiita yaan demmabeenna diraw, taw ayyaanay shemppibeenna. Hewaa diraw, yaan de'iyaa asaa, «Saro de'ite» gaade Mak'idooniyaa baad.
Shin Kiristtoosa baggana ubbaa wode nuuna s'oonoo kaaletsiyaa S'oossaa, k'ay Kiristtoosa timirttiyaa nu baggana shittuwaadan, ubbasaa gatsiyaawaa galatay gakko.
Ayaw gooppe, nuuni attiyaa asaa gidduwaaninne d'ayiyaa asaa giddon Kiristtoosi S'oossaw yarshshiyaa sawuwaa toshikku giyaa shittuwaa mala.
Nuuni d'ayiyaawanttoo zee"iyaa hayk'uwaa; k'ay attiyaawanttoo de'uwaa immiyaa sawiyaa shittuwaa; yaatina, hewaa ootsanaw danddayiyaawe oonee?
Nuuni S'oossaa k'aalaa gelobaadan, walakkiide zal"iyaa hara c'ora asatuwaa mala gidokko; shin S'oossay nuuna kiittina, ammanettiide S'oossaa sintsan Kiristtoosa baggana k'aalaa odeetto.
